name: Frequencies
source:
Elliot, our protagonist, finds an odd pair of headphones. By using the headphones his eyes are opened and his life is changed. However, everything has a price.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=11977]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
我们的主角艾略特找到了一副奇怪的耳机。通过使用耳机，他的眼睛被打开了，他的生活也被改变了。然而，一切都是有代价的。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=11977]引理软论坛[/url]]
